findings.evidence: Lines 81–88 expose `tabloid` then state `tabloid_def`; lines 243–259 expose `spechtModule` then characterize its `toSubmodule`.
findings.fix: Remove both `@[expose]` attributes and use the existing characteristic lemmas where unfolding is needed.
findings.issue: `tabloid` and `spechtModule` (line 243) are `@[expose]` even though `tabloid_def` and `spechtModule_toSubmodule` provide their defining API, exposing implementation details to downstream proofs.

findings.evidence: Each lemma rewrites a constructed/relabelled polytabloid or its coefficient to an action, sign, or `1`, with strictly simpler right-hand sides.
findings.fix: Mark these three oriented characteristic equalities `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: The normal-form lemmas `polytabloid_relabel`, `polytabloid_coeff_smul_tabloid` (line 180), and `polytabloid_coeff_tabloid` (line 197) lack `@[simp]`, unlike the parallel `tabloid_relabel`; downstream relabeling and coefficient calculations will require manual rewrites.

summary: The characteristic API is present, but two bodies are unnecessarily exposed and key polytabloid normal forms lack automation annotations.
